description: OAuth 2.0 PKCE helper (RFC 7636 / OAuth 2.1): generate a code_verifier with its S256 code_challenge plus random state and OIDC nonce, verify that a verifier matches a challenge, or build a complete authorization URL (response_type=code, client_id, redirect_uri, scope, state, nonce, code_challenge, extra parameters such as prompt or audience) and return the verifier / state to keep for the token exchange. Validates verifier length and characters and redirect URIs. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/oauth-pkce
name: oauth_pkce
title: Oauth Pkce
